verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at this capability. Navan's MCP docs mention asking about 'flag/decline reasons', which implies transactions can be declined against policy. The pricing page lists 'unlimited policy and approval workflows', and card management covers active/inactive card status. Nothing documents how card controls are configured. Missing for 10: documented per-card restrictions by merchant category, merchant and amount; explicit point-of-sale auto-decline or auto-lock behavior; independent or hands-on corroboration.
